desc.zh: 从逐个起点重扫到“同进度只留最晚起点”：一遍扫描的子序列窗口 DP。
desc.en: From rescanning every start to keeping only the latest start per progress level: a one-pass subsequence-window DP.

complexity: O(n·m) time for n = len(s1), m = len(s2); O(m) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Latest start per progress level
concepts.description: Two partial matches with the same progress differ only in start; the later start dominates forever.

concepts.name: Top-down slot promotion
concepts.description: Reading one letter promotes latest[k-1] to latest[k] for k from m down to 1 so a letter is used once.
